tools.name: deadmanssnitch_list_snitches
tools.description: List the snitches (cron/heartbeat monitors) of the account with status (pending, healthy, failed, errored, paused), interval, alert type, tags and last check-in. Tokens are masked (the token is also the check-in secret); pass the masked token or the name to the other snitch tools. The API has no pag

tools.name: deadmanssnitch_get_snitch
tools.description: One snitch with its full details, including the check-in URL (https://nosnch.in/<token>). The check-in URL is a secret: anyone who has it can check in and so silence the alert; share it only where the job runs. GET /v1/snitches/{token}.

tools.name: deadmanssnitch_create_snitch
tools.description: WRITE: create a new snitch (monitor). Returns it with its check-in URL (https://nosnch.in/<token>), which the job must call on every run; keep it secret. Fails with 402 when the plan's snitch limit is reached. POST /v1/snitches.

tools.name: deadmanssnitch_update_snitch
tools.description: WRITE: change a snitch. Only the fields you pass change. `tags` REPLACES the whole tag list (use deadmanssnitch_add_tags to add) and `alert_email` replaces the alert recipients (an empty list = all team members). Returns the updated snitch with the token masked. PATCH /v1/snitches/{token}.

tools.name: deadmanssnitch_add_tags
tools.description: WRITE: add one or more tags to a snitch, keeping the existing ones. Returns the snitch's full tag list. POST /v1/snitches/{token}/tags.

tools.name: deadmanssnitch_remove_tag
tools.description: WRITE: remove one tag from a snitch (the snitch itself is untouched). Returns the remaining tags. DELETE /v1/snitches/{token}/tags/{tag}.

tools.name: deadmanssnitch_pause_snitch
tools.description: WRITE: pause a snitch, which SILENCES its alerts: a job that stops running goes unnoticed while it is paused. `until` says when alerting resumes: 'healthy' (default: on the next healthy check-in), 'unpaused' (stays paused until deadmanssnitch_unpause_snitch) or a future ISO 8601 time. tools.name: deadmanssnitch_unpause_snitch
tools.description: WRITE: resume alerting for a paused snitch (safe on a snitch that is not paused). POST /v1/snitches/{token}/unpause.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: deadmanssnitch_get_snitch, deadmanssnitch_create_snitch, deadmanssnitch_add_tags, deadmanssnitch_pause_snitch · Private data: deadmanssnitch_list_snitches, deadmanssnitch_get_snitch, deadmanssnitch_create_snitch, deadmanssnitch_update_snitch, deadmanssnitch_add_tags, deadmanssnitch_remove_tag, deadmanssnitch_pause_snitch, deadmanssnitch_unpause_snitch · Public sink: deadmanssnitch_get_snitch, deadmanssnitch_create_snitch, deadmanssnitch_add_tags, deadmanssnitch_pause_snitch, deadmanssnitch_unpause_snitch · Destructive: deadmanssnitch_create_snitch, deadmanssnitch_remove_tag.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: deadmanssnitch_get_snitch, deadmanssnitch_create_snitch, deadmanssnitch_add_tags, deadmanssnitch_pause_snitch · Private data: deadmanssnitch_list_snitches, deadmanssnitch_get_snitch, deadmanssnitch_create_snitch, deadmanssnitch_update_snitch, deadmanssnitch_add_tags, deadmanssnitch_remove_tag, deadmanssnitch_pause_snitch, deadmanssnitch_unpause_snitch · Public sink: deadmanssnitch_get_snitch, deadmanssnitch_create_snitch, deadmanssnitch_add_tags, deadmanssnitch_pause_snitch, deadmanssnitch_unpause_snitch · Destructive: deadmanssnitch_create_snitch, deadmanssnitch_remove_tag

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
